items.title: The Hilb functor is an fpqc sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter pic.tex (Picard Schemes of Curves)

items.difficulty_reason: Prove Hilbfunctor^d_{X/S} satisfies the fpqc sheaf property: for an fpqc covering {T_i -> T}, the base changes {X_i -> X_T} form an fpqc covering; compatible local subschemes Z_i glue to a closed immersion Z -> X_T by effective descent for closed immersions (descent-lemma-closed-immersion), whose base changes recover the Z_i; Z -> T is then finite locally free of degree d by descent of the finite locally free property (descent-lemma-descending-property-finite-locally-free).
